items.title: Amazon SES features for Protective Markings
items.summary: Introduction Government agencies and regulated organizations are required to apply protective markings to outbound email as a compliance and security control. A common approach is to add a custom X-Protective-Marking header, but Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) does not include custom headers in its DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) signature. items.title: Email security deep dive: Manual DKIM signing through Amazon SES
items.summary: Overview Manual DKIM signing on Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) gives you direct control over which headers your messages sign, including the ability to over-sign headers for DKIM replay attack mitigation.
